description: Convert a Word (.doc, .docx, .odt), PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptx) or Excel (.xls, .xlsx) document to PDF, keeping fonts, tables, images and page layout. Use this to turn an Office file into something fixed and shareable.

file.description: Absolute path to the Office document.

output_path.description: Absolute path to write the result to. Defaults to the input file with a "-papyrio.pdf" suffix.

name: office_to_pdf
